Its not like we want to sound crazy or stand out, i mean if science en technology was the answer id probably be a philosophy doctor by now or about to, at some point in my life i had this thought that i should just spend what remains of my life pursuing learning en education and descovery, thats was few years i got so weirdly ill i ways always one sleep away from never waking up which i was eventualy anticipating after endless years of pain en immobility watching time pass by en me stick and barely going anywhere, just spend time in bed read novels get exhausted like i never slept in days just after few hours.

I knew i was in hell, en eventualy i tealised it seem i may live longer cause i have been waiting long already but i kept waking up each day so i figure i may just well claw myself out of hell, hence i can say im a proud hellian now, i have scars and badge to show to a point sometimes i just allow myself to get sick just like the old days, en most times im too confused if not atrugling because 80% of my life till now is one of strugle hence strugle is all i know i build my life around the suffering en fighting and resisting en improving constantly basically clawing upwards, hence now that im kinda out im paralyzed sometimes because i never planned that far en mydreams where simplified during my journey hence im kinda done hence i twnd to say what now. 

People like video worry of death en the after at old age or when they loose someone but those like me were always staring death daily was pretty much a walking corpse of some kinds so people like this at young age they tend to die due to suffering from some yet incurable ailment, so i figure i was gonna follow them soon, but days years kept pilling, im 37 or 8 en this started when im 22 or 23 , this is why i tend to say to myself that one thing that i know is spirituality well version of it since i went in with evrything i have it was the only option i have left, onething in this world that is guranteed is ailment en death en the world is full of it en i didnt think im special , since i couldnt avoid the next step was to plunge in the darkness en actually see what so scary about it anyway it better than just worrying.

So yep, a lot of many things happened many are still happening, if i dont think of spirituality related issue en pindering it means something has captured my full attention in that moment ,
